name: Monoid.distinct_powers_or_idempotent_pow
statement:
theorem distinct_powers_or_idempotent_pow (x : M) :
    (∀ i j : ℕ+, i ≠ j → x ^ (i : ℕ) ≠ x ^ (j : ℕ)) ∨
    (∃ k : ℕ+, x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ))

name: Monoid.exists_idem_pow_aux
statement:
lemma exists_idem_pow_aux (x : M) (a e : ℕ)
    (h : x ^ (a + (e + 1)) = x ^ a) :
    ∃ k : ℕ+, x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ)

name: Monoid.forall_isUnit_or_exists_idempotent_pow_ne_one
statement:
theorem forall_isUnit_or_exists_idempotent_pow_ne_one [Finite M] :
    (∀ x : M, IsUnit x) ∨
      ∃ (x : M) (k : ℕ+), x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ) ∧ x ^ (k : ℕ) ≠ 1

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.isInverseOf_inv
statement: theorem isInverseOf_inv : IsInverseOf a⁻¹ a

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.isRegularElem
statement: theorem isRegularElem : IsRegularElem a

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.idempotent_mul_comm
statement:
theorem idempotent_mul_comm {e f : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : e * f = f * e

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.inv_idem
statement: theorem inv_idem {e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : e⁻¹ = e

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.inv_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem inv_inv (a : S) : a⁻¹⁻¹ = a

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_conj
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_conj {e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (a : S) :
    IsIdempotentElem (a⁻¹ * (e * a))

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_inv_mul
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem_inv_mul (a : S) : IsIdempotentElem (a⁻¹ * a)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_mul
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_mul {e f : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : IsIdempotentElem (e * f)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_mul_inv
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem_mul_inv (a : S) : IsIdempotentElem (a * a⁻¹)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.mul_inv_rev
statement: theorem mul_inv_rev (a b : S) : (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.eq_mul_inv_mul_of_le
statement: theorem eq_mul_inv_mul_of_le {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) : a = b * (a⁻¹ * a)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.inv_le_inv
statement: protected theorem inv_le_inv {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) : a⁻¹ ≤ b⁻¹

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.inv_le_inv_iff
statement: @[simp] protected theorem inv_le_inv_iff {a b : S} : a⁻¹ ≤ b⁻¹ ↔ a ≤ b

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.le_def
statement: theorem le_def {a b : S} : a ≤ b ↔ a = a * a⁻¹ * b

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.le_iff_eq_mul
statement: theorem le_iff_eq_mul {e b : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : e ≤ b ↔ e = e * b

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.le_iff_eq_mul_inv_mul
statement: theorem le_iff_eq_mul_inv_mul {a b : S} : a ≤ b ↔ a = b * (a⁻¹ * a)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.le_iff_exists_idem_mul
statement:
theorem le_iff_exists_idem_mul {a b : S} :
    a ≤ b ↔ ∃ e : S, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ a = e * b

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.le_iff_exists_mul_idem
statement:
theorem le_iff_exists_mul_idem {a b : S} :
    a ≤ b ↔ ∃ f : S, IsIdempotentElem f ∧ a = b * f

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.le_of_eq_mul_idem
statement:
theorem le_of_eq_mul_idem {a b f : S} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (hab : a = b * f) :
    a ≤ b

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.mul_le_left
statement: theorem mul_le_left {a f : S} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : a * f ≤ a

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.mul_le_mul
statement:
protected theorem mul_le_mul {a b c d : S} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    a * c ≤ b * d

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.mul_le_right
statement: theorem mul_le_right {e b : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : e * b ≤ b

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.mem_vagnerMap_source_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vagnerMap_source_iff (a x : S) :
    x ∈ (vagnerMap a).source ↔ ∃ s : S, x = s * (a * a⁻¹)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem vagnerMap_apply (a x : S) : vagnerMap a x = x * a

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_injective
statement:
theorem vagnerMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (vagnerMap : S → PartialEquiv S S)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem vagnerMap_source (a : S) :
    (vagnerMap a).source = {x | x * (a * a⁻¹) = x}

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem vagnerMap_target (a : S) :
    (vagnerMap a).target = {y | y * (a⁻¹ * a) = y}

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_trans
statement:
theorem vagnerMap_trans (a b : S) :
    vagnerMap (a * b) = (vagnerMap a).trans (vagnerMap b)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.InverseSemigroup.vagner_preston
statement:
theorem vagner_preston :
    ∃ θ : S → PartialEquiv S S,
      Function.Injective θ ∧ ∀ a b : S, θ (a * b) = (θ a).trans (θ b)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrixSimple.mul_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma mul_def (x y : ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P) :
    x * y = ⟨x.row, x.mid * P x.col y.row * y.mid, y.col⟩

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_none
statement:
@[simp] lemma elem_mul_of_none {l : Λ} {j : I} (h : P l j = none)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    (elem i a l : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) * elem j b m = 0

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma elem_mul_of_some {l : Λ} {j : I} {p : G} (h : P l j = some p)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    (elem i a l : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) * elem j b m = elem i (a * p * b) m

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.elem_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma elem_ne_zero {i : I} {g : G} {l : Λ} :
    (elem i g l : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) ≠ 0

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.mul_assoc'
statement:
protected theorem mul_assoc' (x y z : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) :
    ReesMatrix.mul (ReesMatrix.mul x y) z = ReesMatrix.mul x (ReesMatrix.mul y z)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none
statement:
protected lemma mul_elem_of_none {l : Λ} {j : I} (h : P l j = none)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    ReesMatrix.mul (elem i a l) (elem j b m) = (zero : ReesMatrix G I Λ P)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some
statement:
protected lemma mul_elem_of_some {l : Λ} {j : I} {p : G} (h : P l j = some p)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    ReesMatrix.mul (elem i a l) (elem j b m) = (elem i (a * p * b) m : ReesMatrix G I Λ P)

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.mul_zero'
statement: protected lemma mul_zero' (x : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) : ReesMatrix.mul x zero = zero

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.zero_def
statement: lemma zero_def : (0 : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) = zero

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.zero_mul'
statement: protected lemma zero_mul' (x : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) : ReesMatrix.mul zero x = zero

name: Tengoku.Semigroup.ReesMatrix.zero_ne_elem
statement:
@[simp] lemma zero_ne_elem {i : I} {g : G} {l : Λ} :
    (0 : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) ≠ elem i g l
